header: A numbered sequence along a connector
lead: Steps in the order an editor puts them, joined by a line so the sequence reads before the words do. Below the small breakpoint the connector becomes a vertical rail.

steps.title: Numbers follow the order
steps.text: Reordering the children renumbers the band, because the figures come from the list's own counter.

steps.title: Two to four across
steps.text: The column count is fixed rather than fluid, so a three-step process never reflows into two.

steps.title: Horizontal or vertical
steps.text: The vertical variant keeps the rail at every width, which suits a sequence with a lot to say per step.
